title: Wittenberg Day Trip from Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The ICE reaches Lutherstadt Wittenberg from Berlin Hauptbahnhof in 41 to 42 minutes, roughly every hour.** The RE3 regional train takes 1 hour 27 minutes and runs about every two hours, also stopping at Potsdamer Platz and Südkreuz. Times checked on 4 September 2026.

**The 63 euro Deutschlandticket covers the RE3 door to door.** The Brandenburg-Berlin-Ticket does NOT reach Wittenberg: the town is in Saxony-Anhalt, so the flat group ticket that wins for Potsdam ends at the state border.
**Everything sits on one 1.9 kilometre street line** from the station side of town to the Castle Church: Luther oak, Augusteum, Melanchthonhaus, market square, Town Church, Theses Door.

**The Lutherhaus is closed for renovation until spring 2027.** Its highlights, including Luther's monk's habit and the first Wittenberg complete German Bible, hang in the Augusteum next door: daily 10:00 to 18:00, 6 euros.

**The Castle Church with the bronze Theses Door and Luther's grave charges a 3 euro preservation fee**, tower 3 euros with last ascent at 16:00. A 5 euro combined ticket covers both churches, under 18s free.
**Arrive mid-morning, not early.** Churches open at 10:00 or 11:00, so the 09:27 ICE or the 10:40 RE3 lands you there exactly when doors unlock. Five to six hours in town is enough.
